components.name: Botao de confirmacao
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#39FF14; color:#000000; border:4px solid #000000; border-radius:0; box-shadow:6px 6px 0 #000000; padding:12px 16px; font:700 14px 'Courier New',monospace; } .ds-btn-primary:hover,.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:4px solid #000000; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow:0 0 0 #000000; transform:translate(6px,6px); }

components.name: Campo de item
components.css: .ds-label { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#000000; font:700 12px 'Courier New',monospace; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-input { background:#F4F0EB; color:#000000; border:4px solid #000000; border-radius:0; padding:12px; font:700 16px 'Courier New',monospace; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:4px solid #000000; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: Tipiti combina uma folha de controle de compra impressa com a energia de um fliperama de bairro. Informacao de compra ocupa o espaco e evita telas vazias.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Todo contêiner, campo e botão tem borda preta sólida de 4px.

dos: Do comunicar compra por texto, icone e risco.
donts: Don't usar gradientes ou sombras difusas.
Don't usar ícones modernos de biblioteca.
